name: Flow Map
summary: Origin -> destination flows as curved arcs: width by value, colour by category, arrowheads, nodes sized by total flow, travelling-dot animation.
summary_zh: 以弧线展示起点到终点的流向：线宽表示金额，颜色区分类别，箭头指向目的地，节点大小表示总流量，带流动光点动画。
description_zh: 适合展示跨境并购、资本流动、贸易或客户迁移等“从哪里到哪里”的关系。每行一条流（起点/终点名称和经纬度、数值、可选笔数和类别）；相同起终点+类别的行自动合并。弧线宽度与数值成正比、箭头指向目标国，节点圆按流入+流出总额缩放并标注前 N 个国家。悬停某条弧线会突出该流并显示金额、笔数和占比；悬停国家节点会突出它的全部进出流量并显示净流出。点击弧线或图例按类别（如行业）交叉筛选其他图表。
best_for: Cross-border M&A by acquirer -> target country
Capital / trade / supply flows between regions
Client or revenue migration between markets
avoid_when: More than ~60 flows (aggregate first or set maxFlows)
Flows without a meaningful geography (use sankey or chord)

count.desc: Number of deals / transactions shown in tooltips

color.desc: Category for arc colour and the clickable legend

widthRange.desc: Stroke width (px) of the smallest / largest flow, linear in value

curvature.desc: Arc bend (0 = straight); long arcs are flattened to stay on the map, parallel flows fan out

arrows.desc: Arrowheads at the destination (direction survives print)

animate.desc: Travelling dots along each arc (CSS; off for print / reduced motion)

nodes.desc: Country circles sized by inbound + outbound total

nodeSizeRange.desc: Min / max node radius in px

labels.desc: Label the top N countries by total flow (0 = none)

flowLabels.desc: Value labels at the apex of the top N flows (0 = none)

maxFlows.desc: Keep only the N largest flows

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

tooltip.desc: Extra fields listed in the flow tooltip

fit.desc: Initial view: 'data' | 'world' | [[south, west], [north, east]] | {center: [lat, lon], zoom}

filterField.desc: Field used for click-to-filter; defaults to encode.color, else encode.from

scrollZoom.desc: Mouse-wheel zoom: true | false | 'click' (armed after clicking the map)

interactions: Hover a flow to isolate it (tooltip: from -> to, value, deals, share)
Hover a country to isolate its inbound / outbound flows (tooltip: in, out, net)
Click a flow or legend category to cross-filter
Arcs draw in on render; travelling dots show direction
